WITH inserted_acc AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.client_accounts (company_name, domain, status)
  SELECT {{ $json.sql_company ? "'" + $json.sql_company + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.sql_domain ? "'" + $json.sql_domain + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'prospect'
  WHERE {{ $json.sql_company ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}
  ON CONFLICT (domain) DO UPDATE SET company_name = EXCLUDED.company_name
  RETURNING id
),
inserted_person AS (
  INSERT INTO cdp.persons (first_name, last_name, primary_email, linkedin_url, status)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.sql_first_name }}', '{{ $json.sql_last_name }}', '{{ $json.sql_email }}', '{{ $json.sql_profile_url }}', 'active')
  ON CONFLICT (primary_email) DO UPDATE SET
    first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
    last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
    linkedin_url = EXCLUDED.linkedin_url
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO cdp.leads (source, source_lead_id, first_name, last_name, email, company_name, job_title, linkedin_url, person_id, status)
SELECT 'linkedin_connection', '{{ $json.sql_connection_id }}', '{{ $json.sql_first_name }}', '{{ $json.sql_last_name }}', '{{ $json.sql_email }}', '{{ $json.sql_company }}', '{{ $json.sql_position }}', '{{ $json.sql_profile_url }}', p.id, 'processed'
FROM inserted_person p;

UPDATE s_linkedin.connections SET processed = 1 WHERE id = '{{ $json.sql_connection_id }}';
